items.title: Kenny Barron — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: That was the only time we were in the band together, my brother and I.

ctx.x: It was only a week – a week at the Showboat with Philly. That was the only time we were in the band together, my brother and I. Then I worked with Philly many years later, when I moved to New York. But at that time, that was a big thrill.
I can imagine. What was the interaction? Did you have much interaction with Philly? Did he talk to you? Do you have any recollection?
